item.title: Kennedy Center plans Ticketmaster switch, raising conflict of interest concerns
item.description: The Kennedy Center's former president Richard Grenell was a paid board member of Ticketmaster's parent company at the same time the two parties were negotiating.

item.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave
item.description: Nine members of the Kennedy family have joined the legal fight against Trump's D.C. arch, arguing it would disrupt views and cast shadows over their ancestors' graves at Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: Actor Stacy Keach, who played a private eye and plenty more, dies at 85
item.description: Known as TV's detective Mike Hammer, Keach was a prolific actor on stage and screen. His wide-ranging roles included cops, cowboys and Shakespearean characters.

item.title: Americans across the economic spectrum feel a 'panic' about finances, author says
item.description: Mona Chalabi spent five years following Americans living paycheck to paycheck, as well as those earning top wages. Her new book, Ten Lives, explores why financial security can feel so elusive.

item.title: We are still puzzling over the mysteries of Edgar Allan Poe and Arthur Conan Doyle
item.description: Both Poe and Doyle have generated mountains of literary criticism over the years, but Darkness Becomes Bright and Sleuth-Hound remind us there's a lot left to discover about these masters.
